content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-127. - Exception.
content.summary:
This article shall not apply to the inhalation of any substance releasing toxic vapors
               for medical or dental purposes when prescribed by duly licensed and qualified physicians
               or dentists.
(Code 1981, § 21-62; Ord. No. 738, § 5, 10-21-1968)
